name: com.loopland.game
description: LoopLand: a party board game for VRChat worlds. Race around the infinity Loop, win quick challenges, scratch Lucky Loop tickets and finish with the most coins. 2-6 players, particle tokens, 3D dice, persistent Loop Coins, a cosmetics store with fixed-content VRChat Creator Economy bundles, and Free Loop Scratch tickets with gameplay-only rewards. One-click scene builder: LoopLand > Build Game In Scene.
